title: Changing demonstrative statements into negatives
focus: Replace on or ovat with the matching negative olla construction.

exercises.instruction: Write the complete sentence in Finnish.
exercises.prompt: Write “The previously identified book is not here.” in Finnish. While comparing two photos. Source: Se kirja on täällä. (“The previously identified book is here.”) Target: “The previously identified book is not here.” Keep se and the supplied kirja unchanged.
exercises.explanation: Replace on with ei ole; the demonstrative and noun keep their singular number.
